items.title: VST Stock Outperforms Industry in the Past 3 Months: Time to Buy?
items.summary: Vistra's hedging, long-term PPAs, diversified generation fleet and improving earnings outlook support growth, though high debt may warrant a better entry point.

items.title: Beyond Meta and Nuclear: Inside Vistra’s Real Power Play
items.summary: Vistra just signed 20-year nuclear deals with Meta and AWS, acquired thousands of megawatts of gas generation, and committed a billion dollars to an AI venture with NVIDIA and KKR. What CEO Jim Burke is actually assembling underneath all of it is something the headline deals alone do not reveal.

items.title: Should You Buy Vistra Stock For Its Shrinking Share Count?
items.summary: Vistra (VST) has fallen about 19% over the past twelve months and trades roughly 30% below its 52-week high, with softer ERCOT power prices and an expected pause in some Texas data-center reviews among the worries. Underneath that tape, the company keeps handing its owners a bigger slice of itself. That is no longer the reason to buy the stock.

items.title: Vistra CEO Burke Buys 6,665 Shares
items.summary: Burke's purchase brings his total position to 1.2 million shares.

items.title: Can VST's Diversified Power Generation Fleet Drive Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: Vistra's diversified 43,641-MW fleet lowers dependence on a single fuel source and positions it to benefit from rising U.S. electricity demand.

items.title: Vistra Has Edged Lower Throughout 2026: One Bank Says It’s On The Verge of Doubling
items.summary: Vistra has spent nine months drifting lower while Wall Street piled up bullish price targets, and at least one major bank now sees a setup that looks nothing like the slow bleed playing out on the chart.
